A.depoimento: Built two spearmen in Lisboa and dispatched two archers to Santarem and three spearmen to Evora to seize the neutral villages.
A.plano:
Capture Santarem and Evora to gain two villages.
Then advance along the road network toward the enemy capital while building spearmen and archers.

A.depoimento: Built a knight in Lisboa and sent Santarem's two archers to take Coimbra.
A.plano: Capture Coimbra this turn, then Badajoz and Faro next turn while building knights and archers in Lisboa. Advance along the road network toward the enemy capital, securing interior villages and using spearmen to counter enemy knights if they appear.

B.depoimento: I dispatched two knights to capture the neutral villages of Tarragona and Girona, and trained two archers to strengthen our army for the push ahead.
B.plano: Next turn we expect to have taken Tarragona and Girona, giving us three villages. We will then send forces from these new holdings toward Zaragoza and Castellon to continue expansion, while maintaining troop production and avoiding the 300‑troop cap.

A.depoimento: This turn I forged a knight in Lisboa and sent forces to Badajoz, Faro, Porto, and Salamanca, securing each with a garrison.
A.plano: Consolidate the front by holding Badajoz, Faro, Porto, and Salamanca with garrisons. Use their production to build more troops each turn, then push further along the road network toward the enemy capital, employing spearmen against knights, archers against spearmen, and knights against archers.

B.depoimento: This turn we reinforced Barcelona with two spearmen and dispatched its lone knight to seize Castellon, aiming to expand our holdings while keeping our core villages defended.
B.plano: Next turn we expect to have taken Castellon, giving us a fourth village. We will then send forces from these new holdings toward Zaragoza and Huesca to continue expansion, while maintaining troop production and avoiding the 300‑troop cap.

A.depoimento:
I sent 2 knights from Badajoz to take Porto.
I built spearmen and archers in my interior villages.
My front lines are now secured.
A.plano: Capture Porto this turn with knights from Badajoz. Use Porto's production to build spearmen for Salamanca. Build archers in Coimbra and Santarem for Toledo/Sevilha. Reinforce front lines and advance toward the enemy capital.

B.depoimento: I sent knights to seize Zaragoza and Huesca, archers and spearmen to take Valencia and Teruel, and began rebuilding my forces in the home villages.
B.plano: We have likely taken Zaragoza and Huesca with our knights, and are pressing Valencia and Teruel. Next turn we must garrison the new villages, continue rebuilding archers and spearmen in Barcelona, and avoid exceeding the 300‑troop cap. We will not send more troops than needed to capture a village, as excess forces would be wasted.

A.depoimento: Built archers in Santarem, Evora, Coimbra, Lisboa, Badajoz, and Faro. Sent archers from Santarem and Coimbra to Badajoz and Porto, and knights from Salamanca and Faro to Porto and Badajoz, reinforcing our forward positions for upcoming assaults.
A.plano: Build archers in interior villages to mass forces at Porto and Badajoz. Next turn, attack Vigo from Porto with archer-heavy army; simultaneously prepare Badajoz to take Toledo or Sevilha. Continue expanding along the front lines.

B.depoimento: I trained new archers in Barcelona, Castellon, Tarragona, and Girona, then sent Barcelona's available spearman and archers to seize Valencia. The attack should succeed, expanding our holdings.
B.plano: Capture Valencia this turn, garrison it with surviving troops. Next turn, reinforce Valencia and prepare to meet the 6 spearmen en route to Teruel. Continue building archers and spearmen in Barcelona and other villages, keeping each under the 300‑troop cap.

A.depoimento: Built archers in all interior villages to boost our forces. Launched three simultaneous attacks: Badajoz sent troops to Toledo and Sevilha, Porto sent troops to Vigo. Expect to secure these neutral villages by next turn.
A.plano: Capture Toledo, Sevilha, and Vigo this turn to raise our village count to 11. Next turn, reinforce Salamanca with archers from Lisboa and Santarem, then attack Madrid. Continue building archers in interior villages to maintain a strong mobile force for further expansion toward the enemy capital.

B.depoimento: Built knights in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Castellon and archers in Zaragoza, Huesca. Sent a knight from Castellon to bolster the Valencia attack and a knight from Zaragoza to bolster the Teruel attack. Our marching armies remain en route to seize both towns.
B.plano: Next turn expect to capture Valencia and Teruel with reinforced attacks. Hold those villages, continue building knights and archers, and prepare to push toward Madrid and other neutrals. Do not send slow spearmen to Teruel this turn (they arrive late) and avoid building spearmen now.

B.depoimento: Built archers and knights in our villages. Launched an attack on Teruel with three archers from Valencia, aiming to seize it.
B.plano: Expect to capture Teruel this turn. Hold Valencia and reinforce it. Continue building archers and knights. Prepare to push toward Madrid and other neutrals. Avoid sending slow spearmen to Teruel.

B.depoimento: This turn I focused on reinforcing my economy and army. I trained new archers in Zaragoza and Valencia, and a knight in Barcelona. My forces are growing for the upcoming push.
B.plano: Continue building archers in Zaragoza and Valencia, and a knight in Barcelona. Hold current villages and avoid risky attacks until we have sufficient forces. Prepare to capture Pamplona and Murcia next turn.

A.depoimento: I am sending two archers from Badajoz to take Sevilha and the lone knight from Toledo to capture Teruel, while ordering a massive archer buildup across my realms to prepare for the next wave of conquest.
A.plano: Focus on building archers everywhere to strengthen offense, while reserving wood for a knight in Lisboa. Capture Sevilha and Teruel this turn to expand front. Next turns, reinforce Porto to take Vigo, and mass archers to seize Cordoba and Madrid, then push toward enemy capital.

B.depoimento: We dispatched troops to take Madrid, Pamplona, and Murcia while training new archers and a knight. Our armies are on the march to expand our realm. We aim to secure these villages and strengthen our hold.
B.plano: Continue building archers in Zaragoza and Valencia and a knight in Barcelona. Send forces to capture Madrid, Pamplona, and Murcia. Hold captured villages and prepare defenses. Avoid risky attacks on Toledo until stronger.

A.depoimento: This turn we seized Madrid, Cordoba, and Vigo, expanding our control to fourteen villages. Our armies marched from Lisboa, Salamanca, and Porto, overcoming enemy defenses with coordinated archer and knight strikes. Simultaneously, we ordered a massive archer buildup across our realms to prepare for the next push.
A.plano: Consolidate hold on Madrid, Cordoba, and Vigo while building archers and spearmen for defense. Next turn, launch assaults on Valencia and Zaragoza from Lisboa and Salamanca, and take Castellon from Toledo. Use Vigo and Cordoba to secure Burgos and Murcia, then mass forces for a push toward the enemy capital Barcelona.

B.depoimento: Built one archer in Valencia and one in Zaragoza, and a spearman in Barcelona. Sent three archers from Valencia to attack Teruel, aiming to capture it. Marched existing forces toward Murcia remain en route.
B.plano: Continue building archers in Valencia and Zaragoza to reach 5 archers for Murcia assault. Hold Teruel once captured. Keep Barcelona spearman for defense and future knight. Avoid Toledo until stronger.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered knights in Valencia and Zaragoza and two archers in Barcelona. I sent Zaragoza's archers to seize Madrid, reinforced Castellon with Tarragona's troops, boosted Barcelona with Girona's forces, moved Pamplona's troops to Zaragoza, and shifted Murcia's garrison to Valencia to stockpile for upcoming offensives.
B.plano: Plan: Next turn, aim to capture Madrid with Zaragoza's archers, use reinforced Castellon to hold the Teruel front, and prepare a knight-heavy force in Valencia and Zaragoza for a future Teruel assault. Continue building archers in Barcelona for defense and future knight production. Do not split forces; keep each village's send within its available troops.

A.depoimento: I ordered four knights built in Salamanca and Toledo to strengthen our front lines. I launched attacks on Madrid with Salamanca's garrison and on Murcia with Cordoba's forces, aiming to capture both villages. Simultaneously, I redirected interior troops to reinforce Salamanca and Toledo and sent an archer from Porto to Vigo for a future assault on Burgos.
A.plano: Secure Madrid and Murcia this turn, then reinforce Salamanca and Toledo with interior troops. Build knights in Salamanca and Toledo to counter enemy archers. Next turn, use Porto's archer to take Burgos, then consolidate and prepare assaults on Valencia, Zaragoza, and Castellon.

B.depoimento: Statement: This turn I launched a coordinated assault on Teruel with troops from Valencia, Castellon, and Zaragoza, aiming to seize the enemy village. I also ordered production of spearmen, archers, and knights across my interior territories to reinforce my army. The attack should secure a new village and strengthen our position.
B.plano: Plan: Capture Teruel using combined forces from Valencia, Castellon, and Zaragoza. Build spearmen, archers, and knights in interior villages to stockpile for future offensives. Avoid attacking Salamanca or Toledo this turn due to insufficient force. Keep enough troops in Zaragoza to defend Burgos.

B.depoimento: Built many knights in interior villages and archers in Madrid. Sent knight reinforcements to Valencia and Teruel to strengthen front lines for upcoming offensives.
B.plano: Stockpile knights at Valencia and Teruel for future attacks on Murcia and Toledo. Build archers in Madrid to prepare for Burgos. Avoid attacking this turn due to insufficient force.
